brand_vibe: bella (custom, derived from real brand): the salon's real photography is shot almost entirely against clean white subway tile with black grout (every gallery photo), a bright boutique studio feel, with the Italian name 'Ciao Bella' and a real signature in the color work: deep wine/burgundy fashion color (chunky red money-piece, all-over burgundy blocking) alongside warm blonde balayage. Base: LIGHT (ivory/cream), ink deep espresso-wine, accent deep bordeaux/wine (not the gold of 'alea' or the mocha of 'amani'), tying directly to the real interior (white tile) and the real color work seen on the account.

reviews.author: Dimitra E
reviews.body: So good, I want to give 6 Stars! Angela is a rare exception in her industry, obviously very talented and highly skilled, but her sweet disposition is a real plus.

reviews.author: Erica Lachance
reviews.body: Angela is awesome! Her salon is extremely clean and absolutely gorgeous!

reviews.author: Samantha Bajnath Singh
reviews.body: I FINALLY found an amazing salon and stylist with reasonable prices!

reviews.author: Katie Sherwin
reviews.body: Angela is by far the best stylist I've ever come across.

reviews.author: Ninoshka Islam
reviews.body: Angela killed my haircut to the T! Very happy and honestly grateful
